name: Drake
source:
"You sound like you need more special training here!"

Based on Sir Francis Drake, who was an English sea captain, privateer, navigator, slaver, and politician of the Elizabethan era (7 September 1533 – 24 March 1603).

The second-in-command of the elusive Vinland Pirate Corps. Contrary to her youthful appearance, Drake displays excellent leadership over her ruffian band, and courage that garners respect from her crew.

She has a no-nonsense personality, and is strict with her allies and enemies alike. For the sake of unlocking the dormant potential of their successor, [url=/c5154]William Kidd[/url], she is giving her various trials, but there are sadly no signs of progress as of yet.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char07a]English official site[/url]]
